compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a gallery of various nail art designs. The main contents include:

1. A header with the title "Nails.Makeup.Hairstyle" and a profile picture.
2. A navigation menu icon (three horizontal lines) on the left side of the header.
3. A grid layout showcasing different nail art designs, each represented by a thumbnail image. The designs feature a variety of colors, patterns, and styles, including floral patterns, geometric shapes, and abstract art.

The screen is likely part of an app or website dedicated to beauty and fashion, specifically focusing on nail art.
